title: SYX
summary: Marketplace focused on relocating used machinery and equipment
challenge: Translate the company's new moment into a new brand and redesign the existing platform for a functional, enjoyable user experience.
solution: Discovery, rebranding and renaming from Central de Materiais, redesign and prototyping of the SYX marketplace focused on market expansion.

story.approachLead: The brand had to become a platform.
story.approach: Matilha started from Central de Materiais and built the name, the visual system and the marketplace. Sober Blue leads. Magic Green sparks. IBM Plex holds the type.

deliverables.title: Naming and brand
deliverables.body: Renaming Central de Materiais to SYX, with wordmark and color rules.

deliverables.title: Style guide
deliverables.body: Palette, typography, shapes and components for product and communication.

deliverables.title: Marketplace
deliverables.body: Redesign and prototyping of the platform for relocating machinery and equipment.

identity.title: Wordmark
identity.body: syx signs in black, white, Sober Blue and Magic Green. Four readings, one mark.

palette.title: Color
palette.body: Sober Blue is primary. Magic Green is the accent. Dark Syx and Grey Syx hold the product.

type.title: IBM Plex Sans
type.body: The family for titles and interface. Work Sans carries product body copy.

graphics.title: Shapes and curves
graphics.body: Symmetric radii of 2, 4 and 8. Asymmetric 4, 8, 16 and 24. The cover cut comes from there.

system.title: The interface system
system.body: From spacing to the card. Buttons, fields, selection and tags share one grid. The marketplace uses the guide. It does not invent again.

applications.title: From the board to the marketplace
applications.body: The brand has to trade: home, listing, detail and the fixed-asset flow.

seo.title: SYX | Matilha Estúdio
seo.description: Rebranding and redesign of the SYX marketplace for used machinery and equipment.
